(ii) Sn, HCl, heating  →  product containing Sn
(iii) H₂S₂O₇, H₂O, dilution  →  product containing S
(iv) S, O₂, burning  →  product containing S
(v) Al₄C₃, HCl, acid treatment  →  product containing C
The number of reactions in which the named element in that product is sp³ hybridised is
Give the answer as an integer.

Identify product containing named element for each reaction:
(i) PbO₂ + conc HCl → PbCl₂ (Pb in PbCl₂ is tetrahedral, sp³ hybridised).
(ii) Sn + HCl (heating) → SnCl₂ (Sn in SnCl₂ is tetrahedral, sp³ hybridised).
(iii) H₂S₂O₇ + H₂O (dilution) → H₂SO₄ (S in H₂SO₄ is tetrahedral, sp³ hybridised).
(iv) S + O₂ (burning) → SO₂ (S in SO₂ is trigonal planar, sp² hybridised, not sp³).
(v) Al₄C₃ + HCl → AlCl₃ + CH₄ (C in CH₄ is tetrahedral, sp³ hybridised).
Thus reactions with sp³ hybridised named element: (i), (ii), (iii), (v) = 4 reactions.
Answer integer 4.
